tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Fetch the transcript of a public YouTube video. Accepts a full URL or an 11-character video ID. Defaults to Markdown (title + text), which is the most compact format for reading or summarizing. Use json for timestamped segments, srt/vtt for subtitle files. Costs 1 credit on success; videos without c

tools.name: list_languages
tools.description: List the caption tracks available for a YouTube video. Free, and does not use credits.

tools.name: list_playlist_videos
tools.description: List the videos in a YouTube playlist, or a channel's uploads (newest first), with titles and durations. Accepts playlist links or IDs and channel links or @handles. Free on paid plans; Free plan: 10 a day, then 1 credit. Use get_transcript on the videos you need.

tools.name: search_youtube
tools.description: Search YouTube for videos, or search within one channel by passing its link or @handle. Returns video IDs, titles, channels, durations, and view counts. Free on paid plans; Free plan: 10 a day, then 1 credit. Use get_transcript on the videos you need.

tools.name: summarize_video
tools.description: Summary, key points, and timestamped study notes for a public YouTube video, generated from its transcript. Written in the transcript's language (translate_to changes which transcript is summarized). Costs 1 credit for the transcript plus 1 for the summary (2 total) for most videos; long videos cost

tools.name: research_topic
tools.description: Search YouTube for a topic and return the transcripts of the top videos in one call, each with its title, channel, and link, so you can compare what several creators say. Timestamps are kept so answers can cite moments. Costs 1 credit per transcript returned (captions only; videos without captions a

tools.name: watch_youtube
tools.description: Get the transcript of every new video from a YouTube channel, or every new video matching a search phrase, delivered by email and/or webhook. Checked hourly; videos already published are skipped. Each delivered transcript costs 1 credit. Paid plans and credit packs only. Give exactly one of channel

tools.name: list_watches
tools.description: List the channels and search phrases this account watches for new videos. Free.

tools.name: delete_watch
tools.description: Stop watching a channel or search phrase. Takes the watch ID from list_watches. Free.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Show the remaining TranscriptYT credits and plan for this API key. Free.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_transcript, research_topic, watch_youtube · Private data: get_transcript, get_usage · Public sink: watch_youtube · Destructive: get_transcript, delete_watch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_transcript, research_topic, watch_youtube · Private data: get_transcript, get_usage · Public sink: watch_youtube · Destructive: get_transcript, delete_watch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_transcript" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
